finding: Round 5 fixed the LANGUAGE of the prompt_file: field error but not its TRUTH. `nonEmpty('A task description')` / `nonEmpty('A prompt')` are attached unconditionally on agent/llm/llm_map (stepForms.ts:204,210,215), and `prompt` is `skip_serializing_if = Option::is_none` (validate.rs:152-155,162-165,228-231), so an imported `prompt_file:` step arrives with NO `prompt` key. Verified by direct execution of `configErrors`: {agent → "A task description is required", llm → "A prompt is required", llm_map → "A prompt is required"} for a step carrying `prompt_file: 'prompts/task.md'`. The backend disagrees: `check_steps_shape` sets `has_file = prompt_file.is_some()` and emits WORKFLOW_PROMPT_MISSING only when `!has_prompt && !has_file` (validate.rs:682,691-697), and `check_prompt_files` skips its existence half on a draft (validate.rs:1099-1102, the round-4 change). So on ONE screen the field renders red 'A task description is required' (AgentStepForm.tsx:70 → builderFields.tsx:68), while BuilderValidationPanel renders green 'No blocking errors.' (BuilderValidationPanel.tsx:167-172), StepList shows no invalid marker (StepList.tsx:37-41) and Save is enabled (saveDisabled reads only `validation.errors`, WorkflowBuilderPage.tsx:60,68-72). The state is one round 4 DELIBERATELY unblocked; the builder exposes no prompt_file control, so the author is given a false requirement with no explanation of why the box is empty. Fix: make the client schema mirror the backend rule (skip the prompt requirement when `prompt_file` is present).

Downstream of the above: acting on the false hint (typing into the prompt box of a `prompt_file:` step) triggers the real backend WORKFLOW_PROMPT_BOTH, whose author copy is 'This step has both a typed-in prompt and a prompt file — keep one of them.' (validationCopy.ts:94-97). Only one of the two is visible or removable in the builder — there is no prompt_file field anywhere under components/builder/ (grep: zero `prompt_file` render sites) — so half the stated instruction cannot be carried out on this surface. Recoverable (emptying the textarea satisfies `has_prompt = prompt.filter(|s| !s.is_empty())`, validate.rs:681), which is why this is low and not high, but the copy still tells the author to choose between two things when it shows them one.
